segments.text: Then we have beta particles.
segments.zh: 然后是 β 粒子。

segments.text: Beta particles are stopped by your layer of clothing

segments.text: we use the time, distance, and shielding concept.
segments.zh: 我们采用时间、距离和屏蔽的理念。

segments.text: Time, you'll want to decrease your time near the source.

segments.text: completely clear of any radioactivity.
segments.zh: 完全没有任何放射性，就会重新开放。

segments.text: In this next section, let's talk about how to handle a spill.
segments.zh: 在下一部分，我们来谈谈如何处理洒漏。

segments.text: But first, what is a spill?
segments.zh: 但首先，什么是洒漏？

segments.text: The video depicted the nuclear medicine technologist
segments.zh: 视频里演示的是核医学技师

segments.text: accidentally dropping the radioactive isotope on the floor.
segments.zh: 不小心把放射性同位素掉在了地上。

segments.text: That's one possible scenario,
segments.zh: 这是一种可能的情形，

segments.text: but let's talk about some other things first.
segments.zh: 但我们先谈谈其他一些事情。

segments.text: First of all, the most likely location of a spill
segments.zh: 首先，最有可能发生洒漏的地方

segments.text: would be in the treadmill room.
segments.zh: 是跑步机检查室。

segments.text: It's important to note that it may only be one drop
segments.zh: 需要指出的是，可能只有一滴

segments.text: of radioactive isotope to be considered a spill.
segments.zh: 放射性同位素就会被视为洒漏。

segments.text: If you're in the room, please remain calm.
segments.zh: 如果你在房间里，请保持冷静。

segments.text: No one is in any immediate danger.
segments.zh: 没有人处于任何紧迫的危险之中。

segments.text: The nuclear medicine technologist will be providing
segments.zh: 核医学技师会为房间里的所有人

segments.text: all the guidance for those that are in the room,
segments.zh: 提供全部指导，

segments.text: including for the physician.
segments.zh: 包括对医生。

segments.text: No matter how helpful you want to be,
segments.zh: 无论你多么想帮忙，

segments.text: be sure not to reach in to help the nuclear medicine technologist.
segments.zh: 都一定不要伸手去帮核医学技师。

segments.text: That's to prevent any further contamination.
segments.zh: 这是为了防止任何进一步的污染。

segments.text: The nuclear medicine technologist will handle
segments.zh: 核医学技师会负责

segments.text: all aspects of the cleanup.
segments.zh: 清理工作的方方面面。

segments.text: Also, remain in the room until you've been cleared
segments.zh: 另外，请留在房间里，直到技师

segments.text: by the technologist.
segments.zh: 确认你没有问题。

segments.text: Be advised that the room may be closed
segments.zh: 请注意，在放射性清除之前，

segments.text: until the activity is clear.
segments.zh: 房间可能会被关闭。

segments.text: It's important to note that remaining patients
segments.zh: 需要指出的是，日程表上剩下的病人

segments.text: on the schedule may be able to continue with their study.
segments.zh: 也许可以继续进行检查。

segments.text: The nuclear medicine technologist will complete
segments.zh: 核医学技师会完成

segments.text: all surveys and do so under the supervision
segments.zh: 所有巡测，并且是在

segments.text: of the radiation safety officer
segments.zh: 辐射安全官的监督下，

segments.text: in accordance with state regulation.
segments.zh: 按照州的法规进行。

segments.text: For some, the thought of nuclear medicine
segments.zh: 对一些人来说，一想到核医学

segments.text: and radioactivity is a scary thought.
segments.zh: 和放射性就觉得害怕。

segments.text: That's why we are staffed with highly trained
segments.zh: 这就是为什么我们配备了训练有素的

segments.text: nuclear medicine technologist
segments.zh: 核医学技师

segments.text: and an award-winning radiation safety officer
segments.zh: 和屡获殊荣的辐射安全官，

segments.text: to ensure that we are always handling
segments.zh: 以确保我们始终能处理好

segments.text: all regulatory issues
segments.zh: 所有监管方面的问题，

segments.text: so the hospital can concentrate on other matters.
segments.zh: 让医院能够专注于其他事务。

segments.text: Some other points of interest are
segments.zh: 还有一些值得注意的地方，

segments.text: regarding those patients that need lab work,
segments.zh: 关于那些需要做化验的病人，

segments.text: it would be best to have lab work completed
segments.zh: 最好在核医学检查之前

segments.text: prior to a nuclear medicine study,
segments.zh: 完成化验，

segments.text: or if the lab work cannot be completed
segments.zh: 或者如果化验无法在

segments.text: prior to the nuclear medicine study,
segments.zh: 核医学检查之前完成，

segments.text: to wait at least 24 hours
segments.zh: 那就在核医学检查之后

segments.text: following a nuclear medicine study
segments.zh: 至少等 24 小时

segments.text: to get lab work completed.
segments.zh: 再做化验。

segments.text: Another point of interest is that
segments.zh: 另一个值得注意的地方是，

segments.text: nuclear medicine technologists should be the ones
segments.zh: 应该由核医学技师

segments.text: to remove and dispose of IVs.
segments.zh: 来拔除和处置静脉输液管。

segments.text: The exception to that is for in-house patients.
segments.zh: 例外情况是住院病人。

segments.text: In-house patients may keep their IVs as necessary.
segments.zh: 住院病人可以根据需要保留静脉输液管。

segments.text: The IV will be flushed
segments.zh: 静脉输液管会被冲洗，

segments.text: and the majority of the radioactivity
segments.zh: 大部分放射性

segments.text: will be in the bloodstream
segments.zh: 会在血液中，

segments.text: and not in the IV itself.
segments.zh: 而不在静脉输液管本身。

segments.text: This concludes our short training module
segments.zh: 关于辐射安全的简短培训单元

segments.text: on radiation safety.
segments.zh: 到此结束。

segments.text: Our nuclear medicine technologist
segments.zh: 我们的核医学技师

segments.text: will keep themselves available
segments.zh: 会随时为大家解答

segments.text: for any questions that you may have
segments.zh: 关于今天所接受培训的

segments.text: about the training that you receive today.
segments.zh: 任何问题。

segments.text: Keep front-range nuclear services in mind
segments.zh: 请记住 Front Range Nuclear Services，

segments.text: for all your nuclear medicine needs,
segments.zh: 满足你们所有的核医学需求、

segments.text: MRI needs,
segments.zh: MRI 需求，

segments.text: or any other medical imaging modality
segments.zh: 或其他任何医学成像方式的需求，

segments.text: and give us an opportunity
segments.zh: 并给我们一个机会

segments.text: to better serve your community.
segments.zh: 来更好地服务你们的社区。

segments.text: You may contact us at our address
segments.zh: 你可以通过上面公布的地址

segments.text: posted above.
segments.zh: 联系我们。

segments.text: You can call us at the number
segments.zh: 也可以拨打我们的电话

segments.text: or visit us on our website
segments.zh: 或者访问我们的网站

segments.text: at www.frnsinc.com
segments.zh: www.frnsinc.com。

segments.text: Thank you for your time and attention.
segments.zh: 感谢大家的时间和关注。
